Author: kihtli
Name: Relic Atlas
Description: In-game relic progression from Zodiac to Phantom. Overview shows every eligible job and expansion, completion totals and next stages. Open a relic's checklist, track objectives and materials, and keep separate character profiles. Automatic detection plus manual corrections. Open with /relicatlas. Shopping list compares carried stock with optional Allagan Tools storage. /relicatlas atma shows an experimental ST farming schedule with optional Teleporter travel; automatic travel is opt-in for each session.
Punchline: Every combat relic, every job, every next step.
